### Failure modes and anti-patterns
One dashboard per row of the guide's table. Start a scenario from the [control page](http://localhost:8088); each one runs the broken configuration, recovers, then runs the fix.

| Scenario | Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| [API slowdown holds workflow tasks open](/d/la-fm-api-slowdown) | Workflow task latency and schedule-to-start rise together; queries (and signals/updates) lag. | API slowdown keeps workflow tasks open; workflow task slots fill. | Tight ScheduleToClose; circuit breaker in the activity; fail fast to a fallback. |
| [Local activity slots exhausted](/d/la-fm-slot-exhaustion) | Local activities pile up waiting for a slot. | Local activity slots sized from average latency, not Little's law at p99 and burst. | Re-derive slots from Little's law; set ScheduleToStart so starvation fails visibly (Java supports it for local activities). |
| [Slow call triggers workflow task heartbeats](/d/la-fm-wft-heartbeat) | History shows extra workflow task completions mid-call; queries wait ~8 s. | A call passed 80% of the workflow task timeout (8 s of 10 s). | Shorten the call or move it to a regular activity. |
| [Pod loss: ~10 s latency spike](/d/la-fm-pod-loss) | Latency spike of ~10 s after a deploy or pod loss. | Worker died mid-task; the workflow waits out the workflow task timeout before another worker retries it. | Graceful shutdown that drains workflow tasks (WorkerFactory.shutdown() + awaitTermination); keep the default task timeout. |
| [Duplicate charges after a crash](/d/la-fm-duplicates) | Duplicate charges, emails or records. | Workflow task retry re-ran completed local activities. | Idempotency key per workflow ID and step; dedupe on the API side. |
| [429s after the fleet scales out](/d/la-fm-fleet-scale-out) | API returns 429 only at some times of day. | Fleet scaled out past the size the per-worker cap assumed. | Size caps for the maximum fleet, or use a shared limiter. |
| [Outage turns into a retry storm](/d/la-fm-retry-storm) | API outage multiplies its own load. | Every workflow retrying in process at short backoffs. | MaximumAttempts cap, circuit breaker, non-retryable errors for client faults. |
| [Retry-After above the local retry threshold](/d/la-fm-long-backoff) | Many timers and workflow tasks per workflow. | Backoffs or Retry-After above the local retry threshold (Java default: 3 x workflow task timeout = 30 s). | Keep backoffs under the threshold; hand long waits to a regular activity. |
| [One crash re-runs a chain of calls](/d/la-fm-long-chain) | One crash re-runs five calls. | Long chain of local activities in one workflow task, no checkpoint. | Put a regular activity or a durable step between groups; keep chains short. |
| [Resource-based tuner admits too many calls](/d/la-fm-resource-tuner) | Resource-based tuner admits far more concurrent calls than the API allows. | I/O-bound calls don't move JVM CPU or heap, so the supplier keeps issuing slots. | Fixed-size (or custom) slot supplier for local activities. |

_Not simulated:_ non-determinism from changing local activity code or options without versioning (a deployment issue).
